prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, redesign] Spotlight layout for pet generation waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen using a spotlight layout with progress indicators to show pet generation status clearly.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Getting Ready", "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_prep", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet generation waiting step: Move sign-in screen after pet generation waiting step so users log in right before entering home_intro.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion to Account"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided photo upload helper sub-flow: Add an extra photo tips screen within the photo upload flow to guide custom pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_upload_tips", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"layout": "carousel", "hint": "Follow photo tips to ensure optimal custom pet generation"}}
3: [finish, redesign] Split layout controls center on home intro: Redesign the final home intro screen to a split layout highlighting basic pet controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome Your Companion to Desktop", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "text", "text": "Right-click your desktop pet to open controls, hide, or switch modes.", "role": "home_welcome", "style": "plain", "action": "next"}]}}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Account save reassurance copy on path choice: Add body copy reassuring users that created pets will automatically sync to their account.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Create Your Pet", "body": "Your pet progress is saved safely to your account once created."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Pet trait guidance hint on friend selection: Add a mascot tip component explaining how pet traits influence desktop behavior.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Select traits that match your work habits for the best desktop companion experience.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_hint", "style": "subtle", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop permission guidance on waiting screen: Display background status text with system permission hints during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If your pet does not appear automatically, check system tray permissions.", "show_time_estimate": true}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop background completion notification: Enable optional desktop notification alert when pet generation completes in background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to play."}}
8: [adoption, layout] Compact layout for adoption certificate screen: Change adoption certificate layout to compact view to bring action buttons above fold.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "button_label": "Claim Pet Certificate"}}
9: [finish, hint] Shortcut key hint on home intro screen: Add hint text detailing shortcut keys to show, hide, and interact with desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Use your taskbar or right-click pet menu to quickly show or hide companion."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout while preserving pet creation status indicators is permitted inside onboarding.
Reordering the sign-in step to occur after waiting is explicitly allowed by onboarding reordering rules.
Adding a new helper sub-flow screen within photo upload is allowed as an onboarding enhancement.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout while maintaining its welcoming function is permitted.
Adding progress reassurance copy to the choose path screen is permitted.
Adding a mascot trait guidance component to friend selection is allowed.
Displaying permission hints and time estimates on the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding an optional desktop notification setting to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
Using a compact layout for the adoption certificate screen while keeping its core function is permitted.
Adding shortcut key hint text to the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.
